text.p: Morgan Stockbroking Ltd was recommending Tabcorp Holdings Ltd shares as an accumulate investment after forecasting above-average earnings growth for gaming group in the year ended June 30, 1997.

"We expect Tabcorp will utilise its ungeared balance sheet and strong cash flow to expand its gaming operations. Above-average earnings growth is forecast this year," Morgan analyst Sophie Mitchell said in a report.
Mitchell was forecasting a net profit of A$97.4 million for the current year, an increase of nearly 12 percent on the reported $87.2 million in 1995/96.
The challenge for Tabcorp in the second half of the current year would be to maintain revenue levels with the opening of the permanent casino in Melbourne, Mitchell said.
Mitchell said she was forecasting a full-year diviend of 22.5 cents a share "which may be exceeded if a special dividend is paid."
In 1995/96, Tabcorp paid a total dividend of 31 cents which included a 12 cents special dividend.
